# HLF Pulse — New Zealand Mortgage, Housing, KiwiSaver, Income, Labour Market & Protection Reference Dataset

> Public reference dataset and data dictionary curated and derived from official New Zealand Crown and statutory releases, with clearly labelled HLF calculations and market context.
> Created by: Andy Palliser (Andrew Jonathan Palliser, FSP1004725), Mortgage & KiwiSaver Adviser · Home Loan Factory (https://www.homeloanfactory.co.nz/team/andrew-palliser) | Published by: Home Loan Factory (https://www.homeloanfactory.co.nz/).
> Media Kit & Citation Guide: https://www.homeloanfactory.co.nz/media-and-citations | HLF Glossary: https://www.homeloanfactory.co.nz/tools/glossary
> Reuse Licence: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) for HLF-derived figures & commentary; official statistics credited to their respective publishers.
> Date Standard: Observation Period (June 2024 triennial to September 2026 monthly) | Period End | Source Publication Date | Last Checked (23 November 2026 / 2026-11-23).
> Active datasets: 108.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints
- Structured Data Dictionary & Reality Check Benchmarks (JSON): https://pulse-data.homeloanfactory.co.nz/pulse.json
- Webflow Chat Bubble Feed (JSON): https://pulse-data.homeloanfactory.co.nz/nz-mortgage-pulse.json
- Main Reference Dataset Hub (HTML): https://pulse-data.homeloanfactory.co.nz/
- Media Kit & Citation Guide (HTML): https://www.homeloanfactory.co.nz/media-and-citations

## Canonical Data Dictionary Records (108 Active Datasets)
- [ACC Earners' Levy rate, Maximum Liable Earnings cap & 80% weekly compensation ceiling (Obs: 2026/27 Tax Year (1 Apr 2026 – 31 Mar 2027) | End: 2027-03-31 | Published: 2026-04-01 (1 Apr 2026))](https://pulse-data.homeloanfactory.co.nz/acc-earners-levy-cap/): For the 2026/27 tax year, the ACC Earners' Levy is $1.75 per $100 (1.75% incl. GST) up to a Maximum Liable Earnings cap of $156,641 (a maximum annual levy of $2,741.22), capping ACC's 80% weekly compensation at $125,312.80/year ($2,409.86/week gross). [Official Data: ACC / IRD 2026/27 Statutory Schedule: Earners' levy = $1.75 per $100 incl. GST ($1.52 excl. GST); Maximum liable earnings = $156,641 (vs $152,790 in 2025/26). | HLF Calculation: Max Levy: ($156,641 ÷ 100) × $1.75 = $2,741.22/yr | Max 80% Comp: $156,641 × 80% = $125,312.80/yr ($2,409.86/wk) | Derived by HLF Pulse: Yes (HLF-derived from official series) | Cite as: HLF Pulse, Home Loan Factory. "ACC Earners' Levy rate, Maximum Liable Earnings cap & 80% weekly compensation ceiling," 2026/27 Tax Year (1 Apr 2026 – 31 Mar 2027). Derived by HLF from Accident Compensation Corporation (ACC) & Inland Revenue — Earners' Levy Statutory Schedule. https://pulse-data.homeloanfactory.co.nz/acc-earners-levy-cap/ (checked 23 November 2026). CC BY 4.0.]

[Official Data: RBNZ Table B6 & B30 (September 2026): Existing housing loan book yield = 4.81%; New settled 1-year fixed rate = 4.82%. | HLF Calculation: Existing Housing Loan Yield (Table B6) = 4.81% vs 1Y Newly Settled Rate (Table B30) = 4.82% (Spread = -1 bps) | Derived by HLF Pulse: Yes (HLF-derived from official series) | Cite as: HLF Pulse, Home Loan Factory.
